name: Helix Drop
description: Spin your tower, thread the gaps, and dive deeper than your friends.
howToPlay: Hold left or right to spin the tower. The ball bounces by itself; aim for the empty gaps.
Cross-marked danger costs a life. Three gaps without a bounce charge one smash.
Race for 60 seconds. Best depth stays after a crash; deepest wins. Three lives by default.
tagline: Spin the tower. Thread the gaps. Deepest wins.
